file: Social Studies - Georgia Department of Education-CASE-items.csv
structure: CASE (Common Standards... Frameworks) export as a CSV: each unit is one row 'Item Type | Sequence | Human Code | Full Statement | Ed. Level | Last Modified' in hierarchical order. Top: header row, then two KG-12 skills charts (Map and Globe Skills SSMGS1-12; Information Processing Skills SSIPS1-17). Then 'Grade Level' band rows (Elementary K-5, Middle School 6-8, High School 9-12). Under K-8 each 'Course' row is 'Social Studies/Grade N' (Ed. Level KG, 01..08) holding Clusters (Historical/Geographic/Government-Civic/Economic Understandings; in Grades 6-7 wrapped in regional Domains such as Latin America and Canada, Europe, Australia, Africa, Southwest Asia, Southern and Eastern Asia; Grade 8 = Georgia Studies) with Content Standards (codes like SS4H1, SS6G1) and lettered Elements (SS4H1.a); each grade also repeats Map and Globe Skills / Information Processing Skills with proficiency levels (Introduced, Developing, Mastery, Apply and Improve Mastered Skills) and grades 6-8 repeat the RHSS/WHST literacy standards. High School (09-12): shared RHSS/WHST literacy standards for 9-10 and 11-12 (backup), then one Course row per HS course (course title = Full Statement, e.g. 'United States History', 'World History', 'American Government/Civics', 'Personal Finance and Economics') whose Cluster/Domain/Topic rows, Content Standards (SS... codes) and Elements belong to that course until the next Course row; some older courses use numbered 'Standard' items. Finally a '**Deprecated**' Grade Level with the replaced Economics course (backup). No examples/teacher notes exist in this export.

issues: u2-u32: Top-level 'Map and Globe Skills K-12' and 'Information Processing Skills K-12' charts (Ed. Level KG-12) labeled grades K-12 standards, copied to every grade.

u84-u86 and similar skill blocks nested inside each K-5 grade (Domain/Skill rows 'Map and Globe Skills', 'Information Processing Skills'): Ed. Level on these rows says KG-12 (some rows say KG, 01, etc.) but each item carries a grade-specific proficiency tag such as (Introduced), (Developing), (Mastery), (Apply and Improve Mastered Skills); labeled with the enclosing grade (K,1,2,3,4,5) rather than K-12. Examples: u84-u88 (K), u113-u124 (1), u157-u173 (2), u219-u241 (3), u295-u324 (4), u391-u420 (5).

Grade 6, 7, 8 course sections each repeat the identical 6-8 RHSS/WHST literacy standards (Ed. Level 06-08): u555-u595 (grade 6), u752-u792 (grade 7), u931-u971 (grade 8). Labeled backup with the enclosing grade (6, 7, 8 respectively) instead of 6-8 so copies are not triplicated in each grade; the CASE rows themselves mark Ed. Level 06-08.

Grade 6-8 Information Processing Skills and Map and Globe Skills domains (u596-u626, u793-u823, u972-u1002) carry Ed. Level of a single grade (06, 07, 08) and are labeled with that grade as standards.

u1003-u1085: High School Literacy Standards (RHSS/WHST, CCSS-based) are shared HS literacy content with no course; labeled backup, course null, grades 9-10 (u1005-u1045) and 11-12 (u1046-u1085); u1003 (band header) standards 9-12 and u1004 (cluster title) backup 9-12.

u1086, u1087, u1088, u1297, u1354, u1762, u1986, u1987, u1988: HS Course rows with no child standards in this CASE export (Comparative Religions, Current Issues, The Humanities/Social Studies, Ethnic Studies, The Individual and the Law, Latin American Studies, History and Literature of the Old Testament, History and Literature of the New Testament, United States and World Affairs); only the course title row is labeled.

u1482-u1491: Ed. Level field is missing (the Ed. Level column is empty so the row shows only the date) for Personal Finance and Economics SSEF2-SSEF4 rows; grade 9-12 inferred from the enclosing course.

u1213-u1217, u1578-u1615, u1735-u1761: Anthropology, Comparative Political/Economic Systems and Asian Studies standards are old-style numbered 'Standard' items (e.g. '1. Defines Anthropology.'); numbering in Asian Studies (u1735-u1761) is non-sequential across clusters (1,2,3,6,7,8,11,...) as exported.

u1339: Human Code and statement run together ('CT21CTPExamines | the relationship of court procedure...'); extraction/data-entry error in the source CSV, labeled as a standard of Constitutional Theory.
u1332: Topic row 'FCL | Family and Consumer Laws' has the Human Code and title merged into the title position in the source.
u1173-u1210 (Sports in United States Society): codes use 'SSSUSSl' (lowercase L) and 'Ill' for III in the text (e.g. u1189) as in the source.

u1989-u2085: Deprecated item types ('Deprecated' Economics course replaced by Personal Finance and Economics, SSEF/SSEMI/SSEMA/SSEIN/SSEPF codes) labeled backup, grades 9-12, course null, per state guide.

Course titles taken from the Course row's Full Statement: 'Personal Finance and Economics' (u1475-u1575) contains domains Fundamentals of Economic Decision-Making, Personal Finance, Microeconomics, International, Macroeconomics as in the document; 'American Government/Civics' (u1355-u1437) has standards SSCG1-SSCG18 directly under the course (no cluster rows).

State guide says Ed. Level 'KG-12' skills charts apply to the grades marked; K-8 grade-section copies were assigned to their parent grade (see above). Grade 9-12 skills copies do not exist in this export.

u421: Grade Level row 'Middle School Social Studies 6-8' and u33 'Elementary Social Studies K-5' and u1003 'High School Social Studies 9-12' are band header rows labeled standards for their band (K-5, 6-8, 9-12).
